checkpoints.description: [1/3] Reject empty personnel names and leave counters clean after fixed-duty validation fails

impact_assessment.why: generate() can schedule a nameless person and a failed fixed-duty validation leaves partial duty_count values visible in the personnel editor
impact_assessment.benefits: Fail fast with an actionable message and keep the editor counters consistent with the ADR-006 failure-state contract
impact_assessment.risks: contract: generate() now rejects whitespace-only names and zeroes counters on fixed-validation failure; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: runtime counters only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first unit tests for both paths, full project gates, explicit staging, no push

[1/3] Clear partial rosters on failed searches and emit RFC 5545 ICS line endings and folding

impact_assessment.benefits: Failure state has no partial roster, and calendar files conform to the RFC 5545 CRLF and folding rules

[1/3] Clear login and registration form state, username, and the clear-database confirmation on logout

impact_assessment.why: After logout the login form is prefilled with the previous username and password because their widget keys survive in session state
impact_assessment.benefits: Shared-device logout no longer exposes credentials or the previous username, and confirmation state cannot leak into the next session
impact_assessment.risks: contract: logout clears auth form fields and username; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: session widget state only
impact_assessment.mitigation: AppTest measurement before and after, full project gates, explicit staging, no push

impact_assessment.benefits: Each month's rest-rule history starts empty and returning to a month restores only that month's selection
